nodes.label: Requirement: Play header
nodes.rationale: Demo removed from the play header; demo only reachable from the start screen's Demo card. 'Spiel beenden' is a red danger Button opening the 'Spiel beenden?' Modal.

nodes.label: Requirement: Round status in the play header
nodes.rationale: Each game supplies status(state) (parts + progress fraction); headers render parts joined by ' · ' in Sora with a progress line in the game colour; no Screen renders its own round label.
